name: support-app
description: Amazon Web Services Support App in Slack You can use the Amazon Web Services Support App in Slack API to manage your support cases in Slack for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a Slack channel configuration for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: delete-account-alias
subcommands.description: Deletes an alias for an Amazon Web Services account ID.

subcommands.name: delete-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a Slack channel configuration from your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: delete-slack-workspace-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a Slack workspace configuration from your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-account-alias
subcommands.description: Retrieves the alias from an Amazon Web Services account ID.

subcommands.name: list-slack-channel-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists the Slack channel configurations for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-slack-workspace-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists the Slack workspace configurations for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: put-account-alias
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an individual alias for each Amazon Web Services account ID.

subcommands.name: register-slack-workspace-for-organization
subcommands.description: Registers a Slack workspace for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: update-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration for a Slack channel, such as case update notifications.
